literal: Oh! Sweet indeed to us, the eyes which caused this pain, they themselves have suffered this.
translation: Oh, it is so sweet! The very eyes that caused me this pain of love are now suffering it themselves.
modern: எனக்கு இந்தக் காதல் நோயை உண்டாக்கிய கண்கள், இப்போது தாமும் உறங்காமல் துன்பப்படுவது எனக்கு மிகவும் இனிமையாக இருக்கிறது.
explanation: The speaker is suffering from the pain of lovesickness and is unable to sleep. She realizes that her eyes are the ones that first looked at her lover and brought this affliction upon her. Seeing her eyes now continuously weeping and sharing in the suffering, she feels a sense of poetic justice. The exclamation 'Oh!' and the word 'sweet' highlight her playful satisfaction that the culprits are facing the consequences of their own action.
